title: Hyperlocal SEO pages + automated prospecting for $1K+ ticket locals
one_liner: Scrape $1K+ ticket locals with 50+ reviews, build hyperlocal conversion pages, prospect with proof the phone rings.
why_agent_runnable: Scraping, page generation, proof dashboards, and prospecting drafts are agent-native. Brandon gates niche, publish, spend, and outbound send.

ops_steps.title: Scrape + score locals
ops_steps.detail: Public scrape of local sites/Maps for ticket proxies, review counts, site quality gaps.

ops_steps.title: Brandon niche/geo pick
ops_steps.detail: Pick one $1K+ niche × geo from shortlist.

ops_steps.title: Hyperlocal page build
ops_steps.detail: Generate conversion pages + call tracking skeleton (go-live needs publish gate).

ops_steps.title: Proof instrumentation
ops_steps.detail: Call tracking, form CRM, simple 'phone rings' proof sheet.

ops_steps.title: Publish gate
ops_steps.detail: Approve domains, public pages, tracking numbers, brand identity.

ops_steps.title: Automated prospecting drafts
ops_steps.detail: Personalized outreach with page proof — Brandon send gate.

ops_steps.title: Close + productize
ops_steps.detail: SOW/retainer drafts; case study (publish gate); SOP lock for next geo.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.tooling_notes: Scrapers, hosting, call tracking $50-300/mo typical band.
unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: Delivery is mostly agent+templates after first SOP. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 1-2: scrape/score 100+ locals in candidate niches
Day 7: prospect list + outreach drafts (no send)
kill_criteria: Cannot find niche with $1K+ tickets AND weak web presence after 2 passes
Pages get zero calls after 21 days live with agreed distribution
Zero replies after 50 Brandon-approved prospecting sends
disclaimer: Research plan only. Not financial, legal, or investment advice. No income guarantees. Brandon approval required before money, hire, pay, publish, or send.
